mentions.name: Pastmaps
mentions.description: Historical maps platform that digitizes, georeferences, and hosts high-resolution 1800s ordnance maps so users can discover the history around their location. Launched US-only and built on LiDAR coverage from the USGS 3DEP program, with a UK and Ireland launch in progress and plans to build a global LiDAR dataset.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is my side project turned solo bootstrapped startup that I've been working on over the past 2.5 years. Pastmaps has been solely a US-focused platform since it's initial launch but I'm currently working on launching to the UK and Ireland within the next week.

mentions.name: PastMaps
mentions.description: This project OCRs 200K+ historical maps using recent AI models as part of a map digitization pipeline, producing data that powers product experiences on PastMaps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm OCR-ing 200K+ historical maps (or at least trying). For example: https://www.threads.com/@that.map.guy.craig/post/DXA59AylJng/media

This has only really become possible within the last 3 months and I'm still shocked at how good some of the new models are at tasks like this.

I'm not a crazy person, promise. I run https://pastmaps.com as a solo bootstrapped founder and this data is so valuable to my customers. It's been a dream of mine to do this as part of my map digitization pipeline and I'm so excited for the product experiences this is going to unlock.

mentions.name: Pastmaps
mentions.description: A "Google Maps but for old maps" web platform that lets users explore georeferenced historical maps using GIS. It is a solo startup in its second year that covers the US, serves about 80K monthly active users, and grows organically through word of mouth in history-focused communities; international coverage expansion is being explored.
